name: optcatalog_load_fx_spec_from_reader_node
description: OptCatalog::LoadFxSpecFromReaderNode loads optional weapon effect-spec reader blocks into the recovered 0x4c-byte OptCatalogFxSpec layout.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent OptCatalog/zWeapon source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1fa0 validates the optional child lookup, EFFECT-over-MODEL priority, MODEL fallback through zClass::FindByTypeAndName bucket 6, animation/attached/model-animation lookups, RANDOM_ROTATE bit-0 update preserving other flags, SOUND count and sample-list population at offsets 0x1c/0x20, and BOUNCE_SOUND count and sample-list population at offsets 0x30/0x34.
The native smoke verifies effect template lookup, model fallback, animation lookup fields, random-rotate bit preservation, sound and bounce-sound sample population, and missing-child no-op behavior.
